visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of hands holds two cat-shaped biscuit sandwiches against a white background; one biscuit is held up to the camera showing its textured, golden-brown surface while the other remains in a dark box. (2) The scene shifts to a retail environment inside a shopping mall with a bright, tiled floor; a storefront labeled 'ONCE DESSERT' features a glass display case filled with cakes, and three people are seen standing in a queue while a staff member in a yellow cap works behind the counter. (3) A black plastic box containing six cat-shaped sandwiches with different colored fillings (green, brown, and red) is shown; a hand lifts a transparent plastic lid to reveal the desserts more clearly. (4) Close-up shots follow, showing a clear plastic spoon scooping into a square container of white cream cake with a brown cocoa powder topping; the camera then focuses on various flavors of the cat-shaped biscuits, showcasing close-up textures of crushed pistachios, walnuts, and dried berry pieces embedded in thick cream. (5) A hand stacks three cat-shaped sandwiches vertically, highlighting the height and layered fillings before pulling one apart to show the smooth internal cream. (6) A detailed shot of another square dessert box shows a white cream surface decorated with a four-petal flower shape made of cream, which is then scooped into. (7) A pink and white price list menu is shown briefly before a person's hand reaches out to take a paper shopping bag branded 'ONCE DESSERT' from the staff member at the counter.
